scientific_integrity: The pointwise birth-death factorial moment formulas, mean density, within-site pair threshold, and higher-order integrated factorial-moment hierarchy are background and not presented as new. The proposed contribution is the compound-Poisson jump-size representation and its Bessel moving-scale limit.
scientific_limitations: Independent-site stationary mean-field marginal model, not a finite-network joint limit.
Multiplicity limit precedes the critical fitness/large-jump limit.
The universal limit requires 0<nu<1, no positive critical cutoff, and n times the resetting rate convergent to a strictly positive finite constant.
No uniform relative error or generalization to different branching dynamics is claimed.
title: A universal Bessel cutoff for immigrant clans under fitness-dependent local clearing
